FIELDS.NAME: Cozy Nest Bath & Bedding
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Cozy Nest Bath & Bedding specializes in providing a unique selection of high-quality bedding, bath products, and home accessories. Our operations focus on creating a welcoming retail environment where customers can explore a diverse range of products, including luxury linens, towels, shower curtains, and decorative items for the home. We prioritize exceptional customer service, ensuring our staff is well-trained in both product knowledge and inventory control to enhance the shopping experience. To safeguard our operations, we maintain effective loss prevention measures including regular inventory audits, functional fire safety systems, and CCTV surveillance throughout the store. With a commitment to compliance with local fire codes and regulatory requirements, Cozy Nest Bath & Bedding is dedicated to offering a safe and enjoyable shopping atmosphere for all our customers.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Cozy Nest Home Furnishings and Decor Store
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: 06/15/2023; Cause: Water damage from a burst pipe; Amount: $1,500.00; Status: Resolved. Loss dates: 08/10/2023; Cause: Theft of high-value towels; Amount: $1,700.00; Status: Under investigation.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B safe, UL 2050 rated, capable of securing up to $100,000 in cash and valuables, fire-resistant for up to 2 hours.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: CCTV surveillance system in place, securing sales and storage areas, with regular maintenance and monitoring protocols established.
